messages:
maria-gomez: Quick heads up — auditor Jess emailed asking for a compact evidence runbook that maps RBAC changes to KMS usage and ties a recent incident to logs. SOC2 fieldwork starts Monday; auditor wants a one-page runbook + artifact bundle. Who can own the artifacts checklist?

samir: I can draft the runbook. What exactly should go in the artifact bundle?

"auditor_jess": Thanks — we need: 1) PR for the RBAC role change, 2) approval ticket, 3) CloudTrail/Splunk snippets showing kms:Decrypt / GenerateDataKey events referencing the CMK, 4) KMS key rotation history + CMK ARN proof, 5) SIEM correlation showing alert -> service account -> key usage, and 6) short explanation of how temporary creds are prevented from decrypting cross-tenant. Keep examples sanitized.

eli: For (3) we can extract the CloudTrail events: kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. I'll draft a Splunk query and a small playback that highlights eventTime, userIdentity.principalId, eventName, and requestParameters.keyId.

samir: Also include the KMS key policy JSON and a console screenshot of the key details (alias, ARN). We should provide a simple envelope encryption diagram and where the Data Key is cached (if at all).

maria-gomez: Auditor also asked for the flow showing how RBAC changes are forwarded into SIEM (rule id + example alert). Include the alert rule and mapping table: control ID -> artifact filename -> proof statement.

"auditor_jess": Exactly — a short mapping table is ideal. Also, please remove any PHI from samples. We prefer artifacts that a third party can replay (sanitized).

eli: Splunk query draft (will sanitize before upload):
```splunk
index=cloudtrail sourcetype="aws:cloudtrail" eventName IN ("Decrypt","GenerateDataKey") keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234"
| table _time userIdentity.principalId eventName requestParameters.keyId requestParameters.ciphertextBlob
| sort _time
```

samir: And a short extraction script to produce minimal sanitized JSON:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z --end-time YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > snippets.json
jq 'map({eventTime: .eventTime, user: .userIdentity.arn, eventName: .eventName, keyId: .requestParameters.keyId})' snippets.json > sanitized.json
```

maria-gomez: Can someone confirm the PR and approval ticket references we should include (URLs + approver + timestamp)? Need those in the manifest.

eli: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — changed role: service-account-inference -> kms-decrypt-perm. Approval ticket: JIRA INF-7234, approved by @samir at 2024-11-02T15:12:00Z.

"auditor_jess": Good. For rotation history, an exported key rotation audit (screenshot or CSV from KMS) and CMK ARN is sufficient. Please list principals who could schedule rotation.

samir: We'll add a signed manifest.md containing filenames, SHA256 checksums, and mapping to control IDs. We'll also include a short narrative 'playback' that walks through reconstructing the incident from artifacts step-by-step.

maria-gomez: Timeline: can we have a draft bundle by EOD Friday? Oncall may need to sign off on the sanitized logs.

eli: I'll assemble sanitized CloudTrail snippets and SIEM correlations by tomorrow noon. I'll include the SIEM rule ID: SIEM-2024-5512 and a short reproduction of the alert (redacted fields).

devops-bot: Reminder — sensitive artifacts must be uploaded to the secure evidence bucket: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/INF-7234/2024-11-02. Use presigned URLs with 48h TTL and label files with manifest mapping.

samir: @maria-gomez I'll create the runbook PR and link it here. Any other deliverables?

"auditor_jess": One more ask: show rollback proof — demonstrate that after an RBAC revert the Decrypt calls fail. A short video is nice but screenshots + command output are acceptable. Please include the exact commands used to test failure and the redacted error output.

maria-gomez: Ok — owners assigned: samir (runbook + manifest), eli (logs + Splunk query + SIEM playback), samir & eli (sanitization scripts), me (bundle assembly + upload). I'll consolidate and post the bundle link here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
